repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a one-shot wait followed by a cycle. The candidate incorrectly executes the cycle body (valve close and email send) in the initial phase-0 block immediately after the wait, rather than deferring it to the first iteration of the periodic cycle. Evidence F2 shows the IR only sent the email at t=60000ms, while the candidate sent both the valve command and email at t=0ms.
changed_locations: script logic: removed actions from phase-0 block, added phase-1 block with actions
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the script to use a phase flag to separate the initial wait/close sequence from the periodic cycle. The valve close action is now moved to the first iteration of the cycle (phase-1), and the email action is repeated in every cycle iteration, matching the IR's structure of an initial wait followed by a repeating cycle.
